WebAudioBalance - Real-World Compatibility & Acoustic Test Fixtures

Standardized acoustic workloads for cross-browser verification (Chrome & Edge) and loudness dynamics tuning.

1. Podcast & Dialogue (Speech Pauses)

Simulates spoken dialogue with natural 600ms - 1200ms pauses. Tests activity detector gating and zero noise-pumping.

Inactive

2. Dynamic Media (Quiet Intro -> Loud Chorus)

Simulates -28 LUFS quiet background ramping up to -14 LUFS high-energy music. Tests smooth convergence without overshoot.

Inactive

3. Live Stream with Ambient Floor

Continuous low-level ambient room noise (-45 LUFS) with intermittent speaker events (-16 LUFS).

Inactive

4. Sudden Loud Burst / Ad Jump

Abrupt +12 dB volume jump (+6 dBFS peak). Tests rapid safety limiter and 10 dB/s asymmetric attenuation.

Inactive

5. Web Audio API Direct Synthesis

Continuous multi-oscillator polyphonic synthesis. Validates direct Web Audio graph capture without HTMLMediaElement.

Inactive

6. DRM / Encrypted Media (Mock)

Simulates an EME-protected stream where tabCapture receives silence or encrypted blocks.
